title: A Labor Day parade with an untrained band and a drunk drummer
summary: He tells how he helped a green band and its drummer through a parade by walking beside him, and credits encouraging musicians.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
